name: Fenrir Will

acquire.equipPiece: One broken-chain band on a wrist with a glowing white paw-print on the back of the hand; pale-blue wolf-lope afterimages.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form wolf-beastman: wolf head with a long muzzle and pointed ears, glowing soul-light eyes, frost-white mane and ruff gorget, clawed hands, digitigrade wolf legs, a bushy tail, broken-chain bands on wrists and ankles and a fang-sword on the forearm.

equip.weapon: A long frost-white fang-sword grown from the forearm with a trailing chain link (Gleipnir).
equip.armor: Pale frost plate: broken-chain bands on wrists and ankles, a fur-trimmed ruff gorget, wolf-brow pauldrons.
equip.hair_eyes: Thick frost-white mane and ruff; glowing blue soul-light eyes.
equip.aura: Pale soul-light aura with cold mist and drifting snow.

beastNote: Fenrir, the chained wolf (God of War's Fenrir / Garm lineage)
lore: A great pale wolf whose will is loyalty itself: a chain-breaker whose jaws gape wide at the end of the world. A will, not a bond: no wolf follows its holder.
pitch: Fenrir is the great chained wolf of Norse myth (here the loyal soul-light wolf of God of War), who breaks Gleipnir and opens his jaws at Ragnarok. Acquire keeps you human, running with quick wolf-lope afterimages and one equipped piece, a single broken-chain wrist band, for a soul-light leap and a loyal speed surge. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a frost-maned wolf-beastman in chain-link plate with a fang-blade, snaring foes in Gleipnir and tearing in with Ragnarok jaws, at the price of heavy strain.
untrained: An untrained holder is bitten by the bond itself: the wolf's loyalty demands a choice, strain climbs while its soul-light flickers and chain-marks burn around the wrists. The will lay dormant until forcibly awakened; if the holder cannot balance it the clash tears at body and core and can kill, and only training the holder's own core and the beast core (best teacher: the beast itself) tames it.

spirit.echo: A tall pale wolf-beastman in broken-chain plate: long muzzle and pointed ears, frost-white mane and ruff, glowing blue soul-light eyes, clawed hands, digitigrade wolf legs, bushy tail, chain bands on wrists and ankles, a fang-sword on the forearm.
spirit.look: An ice-blue orb of soul-light with a broken chain link frozen into its surface and two small wolf-eye glints.
